title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Hurts
Even for inmates serving hard time, love can be a strong motivator; in prison, reaching out to others can be a dicey proposition; some inmates just don't know when someone's getting too close until it's too late.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — The Force LaForce
A new inmate fears the worst; a gang member asks for help to change his life, but first he must convince a staff member with plenty of his own experience on the inside.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Blue Balloons
A young couple comes to jail after a crime spree, but their stories don't add up; one of the jail's most prolific contraband smugglers makes her return, but staff cracks down on the pipeline.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Fight or Flight
The Penitentiary of New Mexico houses both low level and max-security inmates; Level 6 inmates like Chris Shiverdecker, who has a MacGyver-like prison reputation, are still eligible for hearings that could change custody level and security status.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Mail, Nails, Jail
The jail's Special Operations Group is called in to deal with a difficult inmate; a well-known inmate returns to jail, but this time, he's in with his girlfriend, who might be harboring a secret that could dramatically affect both their lives.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E3 — Rock Bottom
Addiction leads prisoners to serious crime to fuel their habits.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E6 — No Boys Allowed
A look at female inmates that start off socializing, but end up creating a lot drama for the staff.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Hugs Not Drugs
Inmates have been dreaming up new ways to smuggle in contraband since Corcoran opened its doors in 1988; whether in the form of drugs or weapons, it's always a race against time for prison officials to find the banned items before it's too late.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Road to Redemption
Bad decisions have landed thousands of inmates in Corcoran; once in prison, they've got two choices, do their time and go home or become even more destructive on the inside; the path they choose could determine the difference between life and death.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E9 — Severed Ties
A grim field trip for one inmate, while another offers up clues to an Ohio sex slave mystery; horseplay in the county jail usually doesn't mean fun and games.
